items.title: Claude Code v2.1.296
items.summary: Subagents can now auto-compact earlier than the main conversation, workflow agents can all run on one model, and the Read tool gains allow_large for big files. Also fixes managed-settings hook bugs, Haiku 5.5 token counting and secret redaction in shared transcripts.

items.title: Anthropic SDK (TypeScript) sdk-v0.133.0
items.summary: Adds types for the Chat and Cowork unified analytics metrics, plus workflows, multiagent configuration and thread-status filtering for Managed Agents.

items.title: Anthropic SDK (Python) v1.13.0
items.summary: Adds types for the Chat and Cowork unified analytics metrics, plus workflows, multiagent configuration and thread-status filtering for Managed Agents.

items.title: Claude Platform release notes, October 9, 2026
items.summary: Claude Managed Agents can now use dynamic workflows (beta): the agent writes a program that runs many agents in phases and combines their results, running server-side as a workflow run. Turn it on through the agent's multiagent field.
highlights: Guide it from the system prompt

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.295
items.summary: Command and HTTP hooks can now fail closed with onFailure: "block", blocking the action if a hook can't start, times out or errors. Also adds OSC 7501 terminal status support, per-upstream model lists for the gateway, and a /copy picker that drops quote markers.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.294
items.summary: Fixes prompt and agent hooks written as plain instructions (like "Block commands that...") that failed to block what they should, and improves how Stop and SubagentStop instruction hooks are judged so Claude is less likely to stop early.
highlights: Fewer premature stops on Stop hooks

items.title: Anthropic SDK (TypeScript) sdk-v0.132.1
items.summary: The TypeScript client now throws before sending a request with an empty path parameter. The rest of the release is CI, publishing and repo-docs housekeeping.
highlights: Client throws on empty path parameter

items.title: Claude Platform release notes, October 8, 2026
items.summary: The Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience (beta, Claude Enterprise), and the API can download Claude Docs documents as Word files (beta).
highlights: Unified Claude chats in Compliance API

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.293
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 becomes the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API (1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens). Also fixes Claude redoing finished work after context compaction, an HTTP MCP connection memory leak and several subagent messaging bugs.

items.title: Anthropic SDK (Python) v1.12.0
items.summary: Adds claude-haiku-5-5 and typed computer and browser toolset tool calls, lifecycle-stage fields and a filter on /v1/models, and url_sources for the Managed Agents web_fetch tool. Also fixes empty strings being dropped in query params and multipart forms.

items.title: Claude Platform release notes, October 7, 2026
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) launches: 1M context, 128k output, adaptive thinking with effort. Code written for Haiku 4.5 can break: budget_tokens, sampling params and prefill now return 400s. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads drop to $0.10/MTok.
highlights: Breaks vs Haiku 4.5: budget_tokens, sampling, prefill
